effectSummary.en: A direct basic hit restores 2 resource, with a 0.5s interval. Splits, ballista shots and shadow echoes are not basic attacks.

productionConcept: An enduring resource recovery emblem: a taut curved bow limb and thick leather draw glove returning its silver string to ready position; a compact amber spark nestles in the glove. The bowstring and glove form one calm loop of renewed effort, no released arrows.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone HELLSCRIPT Ranger skill icon. Create one original square 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. Style: painterly dark gothic fantasy, worn iron, aged leather, bone and muted bronze, sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, restrained brush texture. Large readable forms, limited detail, strong shape distinction at 64px. Entire subject including glow and particles must fit inside central 76% of canvas, leaving at least 12% fully transparent margin on all four sides. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, icon frame, medallion rim, UI panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard or matte. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Use restrained cohesive effects rather than clouds of tiny particles.  Internal identity (do not render text): AP09 Drawing Again. Skill type: passive.
